prompt: Create a vertical Chinese aesthetic wallpaper in a minimalist poetic silhouette style. Use a 9:16 portrait canvas with a deep midnight navy-blue background, softly textured like a dim interior wall at night. In the exact center, place one tall, narrow, vertical glowing rectangle of warm golden-yellow light, like a paper lantern or illuminated window slit, with softly feathered amber bloom around its edges. In the foreground, render black ink-like silhouettes: slender orchid or wild grass stems rising from the lower left, with long arcing blade leaves crossing the bottom and sweeping upward; include exactly 3 small flower clusters on thin stems in front of the glowing rectangle, each with delicate pointed petals and leaves. On the lower right, place exactly 1 small bird silhouette perched on a curved grass blade, facing left toward the flowers and light. Composition should feel calm, elegant, and asymmetrical, inspired by traditional Chinese ink painting and moonlit garden imagery. Keep all foreground plants and the bird as pure black silhouettes with crisp edges, while the golden rectangle glows softly against the blue. No text, no border, no people, no extra animals, no watermark.
